scope: Offline images through unchanged YOLOX-S analysis, image tracking and two-clock freshness; no vehicle controls
clock: Caller-supplied replay acquisition/delivery decimal seconds; inference duration does not advance replay time
preflight: Validate all image bytes, geometry, delivery clocks and dry admission before model loading; emit no synthetic object measurements
inference: One CPU model plan iff any image is admitted; re-read admitted images; no inference for rejected image events
admission: Reuse unchanged camera-tracking/src/freshness.rs and its bounded default policy; runtime decisions must match dry admission
output: Every event retains original clock text, provenance, optional full analysis and complete freshness/backend updates
publication: Existing AtomicReport: fresh sibling staging before input reads, bounded serialization, sync and no-replacement hard-link publication
